methodology.baseline: Workspace immediately before cached-persister completion and change tracking extraction; already includes CascadeProcessor, EntityHydrator and FlushExecutor extraction
methodology.summary: Median of 15 samples of the production current path per case/variant; positive time_change_percent means slower after extraction
methodology.scope: computeChangeSets through the public UnitOfWork API; setup, mutations and validation excluded; no SQL connection
methodology.caveat: Existing diagnostic benchmark also exercises experimental comparison modes; only current samples are used for before/after performance conclusions. Every case validates scheduled updates, changesets, snapshots and repeated-call behavior.
